crates/store/src/migrate.rs | | | REQ-S02-05 — OIDC | An unlisted issuer is never fetched | statement: one realm conveyor; an unlisted iss is rejected before any JWKS fetch; per-issuer cache TTL 600 s with a 30 s negative floor; verify: crates/store/src/jobs.rs; crates/store/src/schedule.rs | | | REQ-S02-09 — audit | Append-only | statement: audit_event grants SELECT and INSERT only; UPDATE and DELETE are revoked after the schema-wide GRANT; action matches ^[a-z0-9_]+\\.[a-z0-9_]+\$; details are capped at 8192 bytes; verify: migrations/0001_platform.sql; plan §5 | | | REQ-S02-10 — SSE | Bounded replay | statement: Last-Event-ID is event.seq; replay is seq > \$last AND topic = ANY(\$topics) ORDER BY seq LIMIT 500 in the subscriber's tenant scope; 15 s keepalive; a 64-slot channel closes a slow client with resync; the LISTEN connection is direct because PgBouncer is transaction-pooled; verify: crates/api/src/routes/events.rs; cargo test -p conveyor-server --test events | | | REQ-S02-11 — API surface | Unversioned /api | statement: GET /health, /health/live, /health/ready, /metrics, /api/me and /api/events; /api is one OpenApiRouter built with .routes(); --print-openapi emits the document and exits before config/DB; verify: plan §5 Endpoints; apps/server | | | REQ-S02-12 — ports and compose | Same inside and outside; never 8000 | statement: db on 5439 (postgres -p 5439), pgbouncer on 6439, app on 8930; integration tests start their own ephemeral container on a random host port; a container that cannot start fails, never skips; verify: compose.yaml; plan §5/§8 trap 6 | | Requirements Catalog — S02 Skeleton (retrospective, 2026-11-21)
